name: Structured Role-Based Prompt
purpose: Role-prompted template enforcing beginner audience focus and 6 clear Markdown sections.
changes_from_previous: Added expert debugging persona, beginner audience context, severity assessment, and 6 markdown output sections.
expected_improvements: Consistent section-by-section breakdown (Error ID, Root Cause, Fix, Simple Explanation, Steps, Tips)
Severity classification and basic prevention tips
limitations: Free-form Markdown headings remain brittle for automated programmatic UI parsing
No formal error classification taxonomy (uses ad-hoc syntax/runtime)
No calibrated confidence scoring or assumption listing
Lacks explicit guards for empty code, cross-language mismatches, or unsupported languages
